text:
ajay: Quick sync — onboarding a 256k-ctx model (experiment). Two quick asks: where do we want the weights to live (public s3 vs private bucket), and we've hit a tokenizer quirk where special IDs shift if pad token is missing. pinging @maria and @chris for gate + tokenizer guidance.

maria: For Hosted assets we prefer s3://redwood-models/eng-ml/<model>/vN/ with a manifest.json that includes weights_uri + sha256. Private customers go to s3://redwood-private/... and we wire IAM. Also note we require a scheme (s3:// or gs://) in weights_uri for the gate.

chris: TL;DR on tokenizer: if tokenizer.json is missing pad_token_id we historically defaulted to 0 which causes downstream special-id shift. We've added a lint that now flags missing pad_token_id or any non-zero vocab_offset. Example failure below.

lint-bot: CONFIG-LINT NOTE: /onboard/256k-demo/tokenizer.json -> missing pad_token_id (fallback applied: pad_token_id=0). Field tokenizer.vocab_offset=null -> treated as 0. This triggers subtoken-shift risk. See docs: https://redwood.dev/tokenizer-guides :warning:

ajay: Copy — thanks. Here's the minimal config snippet I'm submitting with the model (posting so gate checks can validate):

```
{
  "model_name": "256k-demo",
  "max_context_tokens": 262144,
  "weights_uri": "s3://redwood-models/eng-ml/256k-demo/v1/weights.tar.gz",
  "weights_checksum": "sha256:abc123...",
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "sentencepiece",
    "pad_token_id": 1,
    "vocab_offset": 1,
    "subtoken_shift": false
  }
}
```

chris: OK that config looks good — note two enforcement points for the gate: (1) weights_uri must include a scheme and exist (we call HEAD), (2) tokenizer.pad_token_id must be explicitly set and vocab_offset should match the tokenizer metadata. We'll add a soft-fail message that instructs model owners how to set subtoken_shift if they intentionally use non-zero offsets.

maria: I'll add a short README in the onboarding repo about preferred s3 layout + manifest keys and update the gate checklist to require weights_checksum or signed URL. ajay — can you drop a manifest.json to the path and link the PR? :thumbsup:

ajay: Done — uploaded manifest to s3://redwood-models/eng-ml/256k-demo/v1/manifest.json and opened PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboard/pull/482. Re-running config lint now.

lint-bot: CONFIG-LINT: re-run PASS for 256k-demo/v1. tokenizer.pad_token_id=1, vocab_offset=1 present. weights_uri scheme present and HEAD check OK. All checks passed. :white_check_mark:

chris: Great — I'll flip the gate status to "ready-for-serving" for this model once the PR merges. If anyone hits subtoken regressions after serving, open an eval with the offending prompt set and tag me.

maria: Thanks everyone. Shipping plan: gate PR merges -> internal smoke serve on dedicated test pool -> perf/latency check -> canary rollout.

ajay: Thanks — will follow up if anything else pops up.
